description: This file contains unit tests for the 'remove_sensitive_info_from_deployment' function in the 'openai_endpoint_utils' module of the 'litellm.proxy.common_utils' package. It verifies that sensitive information such as API keys and credentials are correctly masked or removed from configuration dictionaries, including handling of excluded keys.

methods.name: test_remove_sensitive_info_from_deployment(model_config: dict, expected_config: dict)
methods.description: Unit test for verifying that 'remove_sensitive_info_from_deployment' correctly sanitizes various model configuration inputs by masking or removing sensitive data.

methods.name: test_remove_sensitive_info_from_deployment_with_excluded_keys()
methods.description: Unit test for verifying that the exclusion mechanism in 'remove_sensitive_info_from_deployment' prevents masking of specified keys while still masking other sensitive information.
